foundation-model.label: Foundation Models
foundation-model.description: Tile-level and slide-level vision encoders pretrained on large pathology corpora, used as frozen feature extractors or fine-tuning backbones.

vision-language-model.label: Vision-Language Models
vision-language-model.description: Models aligning pathology images with text — contrastive encoders, instruction-tuned assistants, reasoning models, and agentic systems.

task-specific-model.label: Task-Specific Models
task-specific-model.description: Models solving one well-defined pathology task: nuclei segmentation, mitosis detection, grading, biomarker scoring, quality control.

spatial-omics.label: Spatial & Multi-Omics
spatial-omics.description: Spatial transcriptomics from morphology, and multimodal integration of whole-slide images with molecular data.

software-viewer.label: Software — Viewers & Platforms
software-viewer.description: Desktop and server applications for viewing, annotating, managing and analysing whole-slide images.

qupath-extension.label: QuPath Extensions & Scripts
qupath-extension.description: Extensions, plugins and script collections that add capability to QuPath.

library-framework.label: Developer Libraries & Frameworks
library-framework.description: Programming libraries for whole-slide I/O, preprocessing, multiple-instance learning, and end-to-end computational pathology pipelines.

dataset.label: Datasets
dataset.description: Public or request-access image, image-text, and multimodal pathology datasets.

benchmark.label: Benchmarks & Challenges
benchmark.description: Evaluation suites, leaderboards and grand challenges for comparing methods on common tasks.

agent-mcp.label: Agents & MCP Servers
agent-mcp.description: LLM agents, agentic frameworks, and Model Context Protocol servers that give assistants access to pathology tools and data.

prompt-skill.label: Prompts & Skills
prompt-skill.description: Prompt libraries, Claude Skills, custom GPTs and similar assets built for pathology workflows, with their failure modes documented.

app.label: Web & Mobile Apps
app.description: Applications a pathologist can open in a browser or install on a phone — counters, calculators, grading aids, viewers, teaching tools.

commercial-product.label: Commercial Products
commercial-product.description: Vendor products, listed factually with regulatory status. No rankings, no endorsements, no performance claims outside the regulatory record or peer-reviewed literature.

standard-interop.label: Standards & Interoperability
standard-interop.description: DICOM, FHIR, SNOMED CT, LOINC, CAP protocols and the plumbing that turns a demo into a deployed system.

validation-regulatory.label: Validation, QA & Regulatory Science
validation-regulatory.description: Validation guidance, reporting checklists, quality standards and post-deployment monitoring practice.

ethics-safety.label: Ethics, Bias & Failure Modes
ethics-safety.description: Known failure modes, dataset bias, site-specific confounding, calibration and the limits of explainability.

education.label: Education & Training
education.description: Courses, tutorials, atlases, slide boxes, societies and conferences for learning pathology AI.

hardware-lowresource.label: Low-Resource Pathology & Hardware
hardware-lowresource.description: Tools and hardware for settings without a scanner, a cluster, or a budget — smartphone microscopy, telepathology, offline-capable software.

meta.label: Meta — Other Lists & Community
meta.description: Other curated lists, newsletters, research groups and community resources.

fda-510k.label: FDA 510(k)
fda-510k.explanation: Cleared by the US FDA via the 510(k) pathway as substantially equivalent to a predicate device. Clearance is specific to the stated indication for use.

fda-de-novo.label: FDA De Novo
fda-de-novo.explanation: Authorised by the US FDA through the De Novo pathway for a novel device of low-to-moderate risk with no predicate.

fda-pma.label: FDA PMA
fda-pma.explanation: Approved by the US FDA through Premarket Approval, the most stringent device pathway.

ce-ivdr.label: CE marked (IVDR)
ce-ivdr.explanation: CE marked under the EU In Vitro Diagnostic Regulation 2017/746. Check the stated risk class and intended purpose.

cdsco.label: CDSCO (India)
cdsco.explanation: Registered or licensed with India's Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation under the Medical Devices Rules.

tga.label: TGA (Australia)
tga.explanation: Included in the Australian Register of Therapeutic Goods.

pmda.label: PMDA (Japan)
pmda.explanation: Approved or certified under Japan's Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Act.

ruo.label: Research use only
ruo.explanation: Research use only. Not cleared, approved or CE marked for diagnostic use. Must not be used for primary diagnosis or to direct patient management.

not-applicable.label: Not applicable
not-applicable.explanation: Not a diagnostic tool — a dataset, library, benchmark, standard or educational resource, where device regulation does not apply.

unknown.label: Status unverified
unknown.explanation: Regulatory status has not yet been verified against a primary source. Treat as research use only until confirmed.

clinician.label: Pathologists
clinician.blurb: Practising pathologists and trainees looking for tools they can use.

developer.label: Developers
developer.blurb: Engineers building pathology software and pipelines.

educator.label: Educators
educator.blurb: Teachers, trainers and residency programme staff.

concept.label: Concept
concept.blurb: An idea, prototype or proof of concept. Not usable in practice yet.

research.label: Research
research.blurb: Published or released for research. Expect rough edges.

beta.label: Beta
beta.blurb: Usable, actively developed, interfaces may still change.

production.label: Production
production.blurb: Mature and widely used. Stable enough to depend on.

deprecated.label: Deprecated
deprecated.blurb: No longer maintained. Listed for reference and for reproducing old work.

runs-on-laptop.label: Runs on a laptop
runs-on-laptop.blurb: Needs no more than a consumer GPU, and often only a CPU. No workstation, no cluster, no cloud account.

works-offline.label: Works offline
works-offline.blurb: Runs without an internet connection once installed, and does not send slides to a remote server.
works-offline.rule: offline_capable is true AND sends_data_offsite is false

no-scanner-needed.label: No scanner needed
no-scanner-needed.blurb: Usable without a whole-slide scanner — works with photomicrographs, camera captures or existing image files.

low-resource.label: Low-resource ready
low-resource.blurb: Free, runs on modest hardware, works offline, and needs no scanner. The shortlist for a department starting from nothing.
low-resource.rule: cost in (free, free-for-academic) AND hardware_floor in (cpu, consumer-gpu) AND offline_capable is true AND needs_scanner is false

stale-shelf.label: The Stale Shelf
stale-shelf.blurb: Listed honestly rather than quietly dropped — projects marked deprecated, or whose upstream repository has been silent for well over a year. Some are simply finished and stable; others are abandoned. Check before you build on any of them. Entries with no commit history are never listed here: absence of evidence is not evidence of abandonment.
stale-shelf.rule: stage is deprecated OR last_commit older than 550 days

beginner.label: Beginner
beginner.description: Install it and open it, or just read it. No code.

intermediate.label: Intermediate
intermediate.description: Some setup: a plugin, a config file, a scanner, or a graphics card you probably already have.

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.description: You or a collaborator will be writing code and handling models, data or a server.
